title: Thus Saith the Lord Who Built the Heavens
description: Thus Saith the Lord Who Built the Heavens in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 252 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “God's Servant”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thus saith the Lord who built the heavens, And bade the plan-ets roll, Who peo-pled all the climes of earth, And formed the hu-man soul:

lines: Thus saith the Lord who built the heavens,
Who peopled all the climes of earth,
Him have I chosen, and in him
My truth and judgment he shall show
"The progress of his zeal and power
Till foreign lands and distant isles

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
